copy.body: The world moves at the speed and cost at which people and goods move — make a dent in that, and you change how the world works. Navier is an American maritime company building high-speed, high-throughput, energy-efficient hydrofoiling vessels and the operating infrastructure around them. Our software-controlled hydrofoils fly above the water: faster, dramatically cheaper to run, and smooth in conditions that keep conventional boats in port. Every vessel earns recurring revenue on every journey — one standardized platform compounding across passenger transport, cargo logistics, and defense, with paying customers and signed international demand today.
